programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race
programs.desc: In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Dozing Dragon
programs.desc: When the Duke and Claw use a magic cauldron to put the people of Barkingburg to sleep, their plan backfires when the enchanted fog works on Sparks; it's up to the PAW Patrol to wake up the Dragon along with everyone else in town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Stop a Super Shaker; Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse
programs.desc: Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.desc: Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Humsquatch; Pups Save a Far Flung Flying Disc
programs.desc: When Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble, the PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch; when a robo-toy causes mayhem in Adventure Bay, Ryder knows just who to call.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Stop a Humdinger Horde; Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Save a Mighty Lighthouse
programs.desc: The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine; Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket.
